days.title: Day 1
days.text: We depart from Cusco toward the Sacred Valley, visiting the colorful Pisac markets, its agricultural terraces and the impressive archaeological site. We continue to Ollantaytambo, known for its remarkable Inca complex. From there, we take the train to Aguas Calientes, where you can rest and prepare for the big day. At dawn, we visit the astonishing citadel of Machu Picchu at more than 2400 masl, one of the most recognized wonders on the planet. You will explore its temples, terraces and viewpoints while feeling the unique energy of the Andes.
